summary: Reconstructed the figure as a compilable TikZ standalone document: quadrilateral ABCD with solid edges AB, BC, CD, DA, no diagonals, and no arcs. Labels A, B, C, D are placed at their vertices. Version 1 compiled and validated, and the critic scored it 0.95 with must_repair=false. Its only note (a perpendicular relation at D) is low severity and does not appear in the TikZ, so no repair was run.
